written_results.statement: For fixed finite prime set S and P=prod(S), a_S(n)=mu(n) on integers with exactly one prime factor outside S, and zero elsewhere. M_S(x)=-sum_(d|P)mu(d)*pi_notS(x/d) for every real x>=1.
written_results.proof: A contributing squarefree n has the unique representation n=d*p, d|P and p prime outside S. Its coefficient is -mu(d). Retain floor(x/d) and every original squareful zero. The complement b_S=mu-a_S is not deleted. The packet contains both signs, not a positive/negative split.

written_results.statement: With kappa=prod_(p in S)(1-1/p), alpha=2^(-1/2), packet localized energy A_S(R)~3*kappa^2*(1-alpha)^2*R^(1/3)/log(R)^2. The fully signed packet core Z_S(R)=A_S(R)+O(1) also diverges.
written_results.proof: PNT applied to the fixed finite d-sum gives M_S(x)~-kappa*x/log(x). The exact localized Abel formula gives U_S(x)~-kappa*(1-alpha)*sqrt(x)/log(x). Integrate its weighted square. The remaining diagonal/ray/large-gcd/short-gap terms cost at most (143/2)c by the existing absolute bounds. No numerical PNT onset and no uniform-in-S asymptotic are claimed. The full core still contains the complement and all mixed terms.

written_results.statement: With full localized reading F=U_S+V_S, A=norm(U_S)^2, C=inner(U_S,V_S), E=norm(V_S)^2, Gamma=A+2C+E=(A+C)^2/A+(E-C^2/A) when A>0. At A=0, C=0 and Gamma=E without division.
written_results.proof: Finite expansion followed by completing the square. Cauchy--Schwarz proves E-C^2/A>=0. All mixed terms and the full complement remain. Uniform Gamma<=B requires |1+C/A|<=sqrt(B/A) and E-C^2/A<=B. The second term is not removed by choosing a regression coefficient.

written_results.premise: Published JLT A.1(A.6), relaxed to |M(v)|<=5*v/log(v)^(47/20) for v>=exp(385). This is NOT a native Lean supplier.
written_results.proof: The exact localized Abel formula gives |F(x)|<=15*a*sqrt(x)/log(x/4)^(47/20). The elementary bound |F(x)|<=6*sqrt(x)/5 pays startup. On u>=385, derivative(exp(u/3)*u^(-47/10))>=(1/4)*exp(u/3)*u^(-47/10); integrate and retain the paid-sector correction. This improves the logarithmic majorant, not the power of R or the target uniform bound.

written_results.premise: Same explicit logarithmic Mertens premise as SP8; S remains fixed.
written_results.statement: Let D_S=prod_(p in S)(1+1/p), rS=max(4*P^2,r0). For R>=rS: |A(R)+C(R)|<=(108/25)*(rS^(1/3)-1)+3240*D_S*a^2*R^(1/3)/log(R/4)^(67/20). For smaller R the elementary product allowance (108/25)*(R^(1/3)-1) applies.
written_results.proof: The central-binomial bound gives theta(2^k)<2^(k+1)*log(2), hence theta(y)<=4*y*log(2). Splitting pi(y) at sqrt(y) and using log(y)<=sqrt(y) gives pi(y)<=9*y/log(y) for y>1. For v>=P^2, the finite prefix formula gives |M_S(v)|<=18*D_S*v/log(v), so |U_S(x)|<=54*D_S*a*sqrt(x)/log(x/4). Use A+C=inner(U_S,F), multiply by the signed full-source envelope from SP8, and integrate using 1/3-(67/20)/385>1/4. The elementary product bound pays startup. No positive/negative core masses are separately bounded.

written_results.premises: SP4, SP8, SP9; classical PNT and the explicit Mertens estimate, neither newly Lean-admitted.
written_results.statement: C/A=-1+O_S(log(R)^(-27/20)) and E/A=1+O_S(log(R)^(-27/20)). The leading packet divergence is cancelled by the actual complement.
written_results.gap: Uniform Gamma instead requires |1+C/A|=O_S(log(R)/R^(1/6)) plus a uniform bound on E-C^2/A. The achieved logarithmic rate and nonuniform residual bound do not suffice.
